note: Legal entity TKIL INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED is the renamed Thyssenkrupp Industries India (same Nariman Point address appears on both ImportKey pages; Thyssenkrupp Polysius GmbH listed as supplier to both names), so the name variants are one company. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs rows with destination, HS code and B/L numbers (Kenya/Mombasa, UAE/Ras Al Khaimah; HS 84021990, 84749000, 83119000) — note the declared HS 840211/843139 does not match the observed 84021990/84749000, so per project rules the code should be corrected to the actual one and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected, not rejected. Industry claim 'IT и электроника' is inconsistent with the observed goods (cement-plant machinery, steam/boiler equipment, castings) — flag for correction, not a rejection ground. Domestic (in-India) supply evidence: not found in this pass, status unknown rather than none_found, because search tooling was down. Revenue/export volume figures: null (not public in free views).
